facts.text: Audrey has a childhood dog named Max who had lots of energy and loved a game of fetch.

evidence.quote: That one is Max, my childhood dog. He had lots of energy and loved a game of fetch.

facts.text: Audrey and Max would take long walks in the neighborhood when Audrey was a child, with Max sniffing and marking his territory.

evidence.quote: Max and I would take long walks in the neighborhood when I was a kid. We explored new paths, him sniffing and marking his territory.

facts.text: Audrey shared her worries and hopes with Max, who was a great listener and always there for her.

evidence.quote: We grew really close, and I shared my worries and hopes with him. He was a great listener, always there for me.

facts.text: Audrey recalls that Max and she had some of their favorite memories from their time together as a child.

evidence.quote: Those days are some of my favorite memories.
